page_title: WHU 1-1 SOU | West Ham v Southampton 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+3' 1 - 1 Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) picks up a rebound just outside the box, steadies himself and unleashes a cracker that deflects off the right post into the back of the net, beating the helpless goalkeeper.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
90' Decent spell from Southampton here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The linesman makes the right call and Southampton will have a corner.
87' Max Kilman (West Ham) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
86' Here comes a substitution. Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for James Ward-Prowse.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jarrod Bowen as he is replaced by Evan Ferguson (West Ham).
85' Simon Rusk has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ross Stewart (Southampton) replacing Taylor Harwood-Bellis.
85' It is time for a substitution. Welington (Southampton) is on for Ryan Manning.
85' Andrew Kitchen blows his whistle and it's Tyler Dibling (Southampton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
83' Max Kilman (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrew Kitchen had an easy-decision to make.

83' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) fails to keep his cool and squanders a golden chance to score from inside the penalty area after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
80' Graham Potter has decided to substitute Emerson and he is replaced by Oliver Scarles (West Ham).
80' Niclas Fullkrug goes off the pitch and Tomas Soucek (West Ham) comes on.
79' The ball is cleared after Tyler Dibling (Southampton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
78' Luis Guilherme (West Ham) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
75' Substitution. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) on for Mohammed Kudus.
74' Simon Rusk decides to make a substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana will be replaced by Tyler Dibling (Southampton).

74' Chance! Jack Stephens (Southampton) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Alphonse Areola is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
69' The substitution has been made. Cameron Archer (Southampton) has replaced Paul Onuachu.
69' Max Kilman (West Ham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
68' The Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Andrew Kitchen rules it out for a foul.
67' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
67' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. West Ham earn a corner.

65' The ball rebounds out to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
65' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
64' Southampton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Now Southampton have a corner.
62' Carlos Soler (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) launches a cross from the corner, but Aaron Ramsdale is alert to thwart the effort.
61' West Ham win a corner. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
58' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
58' Great teamplay by West Ham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
55' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is penalised for holding. Andrew Kitchen signals a set piece.
55' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Aaron Ramsdale pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
52' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug tees up Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
47' Corner kick. Southampton will have an opportunity.

47' The game is pretty dull as Southampton are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Andrew Kitchen blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Jack Stephens (Southampton) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.

41' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
39' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Flynn Downes (Southampton). Southampton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' Ryan Manning (Southampton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Alphonse Areola.
37' Carlos Soler (West Ham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
35' The main referee, Andrew Kitchen, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is given a yellow card for dissent.

34' Niclas Fullkrug plays the ball through an opponents legs to James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
32' OFF THE BAR! Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
31' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
31' Emerson (West Ham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' It looks like Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) saw red with that tackle. Andrew Kitchen won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
29' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

26' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
25' Rough tackle by Jack Stephens (Southampton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was quite harsh and Andrew Kitchen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' A snap shot by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Aaron Ramsdale produces a good save to thwart him.
21' Surely that's handball by one of the Southampton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
21' Carlos Soler (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
20' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is adjudged offside.
16' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andrew Kitchen stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton.

15' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Emerson (West Ham).
9' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
7' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrew Kitchen blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Some patient build-up play from West Ham as they look to unlock the defence.
4' A nice lofted cross finds Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
4' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrew Kitchen saw the whole situation.
2' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Southampton will take a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
West Ham will kick the game off.
Andrew Kitchen got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
